table.retrieve:
SELECT 
		itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END, 
         aliasname=item.customicode,  
		saleperson=(select  name from salesman where salesman.salesmancode=saleledger.smancode), 
         packingdesc=item.packingdesc, 
         accname = dbo.accounts.name, 
		reprintcount=saleledger.Reprintingcounter,
		serverdate=getdate(),  
		custalias=accounts.aliasname,
         address = dbo.customer.address1,   
         address2= dbo.customer.address2, 
		 custntnno=customer.ntnno,  
         salesman = dbo.users.username,   
         saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
         /*headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,   */
		 headerno = 1,
         date =  Case :ar_printdate When 1 Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate When 2 Then dbo.saleledger.date When 3 Then dbo.saleledger.Billingdate  End, 
         invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
         misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
			salecatcode = dbo.saleledger.salecatcode,
         gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
         icode = saledetail.icode,   
         batch = saledetail.batch,   
         expiry = saledetail.expiry,   
         looseqty = saledetail.looseqty,   
         bonusqty = saledetail.bonusqty,   
         packqty = saledetail.packqty,   
         packunits= saledetail.packunits,   
         /*saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   */
		saleprice=item.retailprice/(case item.packunits when 0 then 1 else item.packunits end),
         discperc = saledetail.discperc,  
			itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,   
         salestax = saledetail.salestax,   
         Id = dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
         posted=saleledger.posted,   
         balance=CASE saleledger.Posted when 'Y' Then ISNULL(saleledger.balance, 0)
					ELSE (select isnull(sum(v.debit - v.credit), 0) from virtualgl v
							where v.acccode=accounts.acccode group by v.acccode)
					END,      
		amt=saleledger.amt,  
		saleledger.printbalance,
         unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
         gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
         invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
         custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
			dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
			dbo.saleledger.remarks,
			dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
			dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
			custcode=saleledger.custcode,
			
			messages=(select description from message where messagecode=saleledger.messagecode)

    FROM saleledger,   
         saledetail,   
         accounts,   
         customer,   
         users,   
         item  

   WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode between :ar_SInvCode and :ar_LInvCode ) AND  
       
		 ( dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (:ar_custcode) )AND   
         ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    

ORDER BY /*dbo.item.customicode,*/
			dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode,
			dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_itemtotal
objects.expression: (  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) +  (round( ((  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )) *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2))

objects.name: compute_3
objects.visible: 1	if(round( ((  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )) *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: round( ((  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )) *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2)

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: (  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: t_6
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(round( ((  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )) *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)  = 0, 0, 1)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , f_NumberPreferences('roundsaleinvon'))  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2), f_NumberPreferences('roundsaleinvon'))

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 1 ) + SUM(round( (round( ((  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )) *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2)) *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2)for group 1)

objects.name: compute_4
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(round( ((  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )) *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum(round( ((  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )) *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: compute_2
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(looseqty *  itemflatdisc for all) + sum((looseqty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc) * ( discperc * 0.01)) for all)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum(looseqty *  itemflatdisc for group 1) + sum((looseqty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc) * ( discperc * 0.01)) for group 1)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)
